title: The Ledger of Bellwether Lane
author: Odile Dunmore
blurb: Noor Crane, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
